paite: Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
heading: Job Thugen Ngaveina
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Bang tan ka kha hihbuai a, thute a hon hihzan gawp ding na hi ua?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

paite: Hiai sawmvei na hon kouta ua; ka tung a giloutak a na hih uh na zum kei uh.
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

paite: Ana paikhial taleng maw, keimah kiang a ka diklouhna a-om gige hi.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

paite: Kei dem in nou kiliansak petmah ve ni uchin, ka minsiatna ka tung ah na gen ding ua,
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

paite: Pathian in ka thu ah hon zouta chih tu in thei un, huchi in alen in ahon umsuak hi.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

paite: "Ngai un, 'Hiamgamna,' chi in ka kikoukhia a, himahleh zak in ka om kei, panpih deih in ka kikou a, himahleh vaihawmna a-om kei hi.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

paite: Ka pai theihlouhna ding in ka lampi a-um a, ka paina dingte ah khomial akoih hi.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

paite: Ka thupina hon suahsak a, ka lu a kipan lallukhu alakhia hi.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

paite: Ning chiteng ah ahon hihniam a, ka mangta hi; huchi in sing bang in ka lametna abotkhia hi.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

paite: Ka tung ah ahehna leng asou a, amah a ding in agalte lak a khat bang in ahon sim hi.
english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

paite: Asepaih pawlte ahong kuankhawm ua, ka siatna ding in alampi uh abawl ua ka puanin kimvel in puanin akai uhi.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

paite: "Kei a pan in ka unaute gamlapi ah akoih a, ka meltheihte kei a pan in atuam vekta uh.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

paite: Ka tanaute'n ahon zuausan ua, ka lawm theihngeite'n ahon mangngilhta uhi.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

paite: Ka inn tengte leh, ka sikhanute'n, mikhual ahon sa ua: amitmuh un namdangmi ka hi.
english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

paite: Ka sikha ka sam a, hon dawng kei, ka kam in amah khem mah leng.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

paite: Ka zi a ding in ka hu kihhuai ahi a, sanggamte ziak in pumpi hahsiang mah leng ka namsia hi.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

paite: Naupang neute nangawn in hon simmoh ua; ka thohleh, ka siatna ding in thu agen uhi.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

paite: Ka lawm thudotte'n kei ahon hua ua, amau ka itte ka tung ah ahel uhi.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

paite: Ka vun ah leh ka sa ah ka guh abelh bikbek a, ka ha vun toh ka suakta hi.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

paite: Hon hehpih un, hon hehpih un, Aw nou ka lawmte; Pathian khut in kei ahon khoihta ngal a.
english: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

paite: Bangziak a Pathian bang a nou hon sawi na hi ua, ka sa a bangziak a lungkim lou na hi ua?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

paite: "Aw ka thute tu in gelh in om le uh aw; Aw laibu ah kigelh lutleh aw.
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

paite: Sik leh ngen gelhna zum in tangtawn a ding in suangpi a gelh hi le uh aw;
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

paite: Ka Tanpa ahing chih leh, atawp chiang in leitung ah adingh nawn ding chih ka theih ziak in.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

paite: Ka vun huchibang a hihsiat a a-om khit nung in, himahleh ka sa a kipan Pathian ka mu ding hi.
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

paite: Keimah a ding in amah kei mahmah in ka mu dia, ka mitte'n a-en ding, midang hilou in; ka sung ah ka lungtang asidang hial hi!
english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

paite: "Amah bangchibang in i sawita phet ding uam, na chih uleh, kei ah thubul muh in a-om chih thei in.
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

paite: Namsau kihta un; hehna in lah namsau gawtnate ahon tun ngal a, huchi a vaihawmna a-om chih na theihtheihna ding un."
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
